text:
maria: Heads-up — carrier put a customs hold on the EU inbound trial racks (order RC-9812). ETA shift ~72h, might impact tomorrow's pilot.

tariq: which racks specifically? can we swap from us-west staging?

maria: 12 racks for EU-dedicated pilot. staging pool only has 6 spare, so not enough to cover both pilots.

olivia: asked partner if they can split shipment (6 now, rest later). waiting their confirmation.
jordan: if we only get 6, can pilot run reduced? product said one customer ok, legal flagged SLA for the second.
tariq: options: (1) reassign EU pool to prioritize pilot A, (2) air-bridge remaining racks from us-west (fast, expensive), (3) delay pilot B with credits.
olivia: partner can expedite 4 racks via customs fast-track but needs an amended commercial invoice from us.
supply-bot: [log] inventory_check --pool=staging-us-west --available=6
supply-bot: [log] inventory_check --pool=eu-warehouse --available=8
jordan: current math: 6 (staging) + 4 (partner expedite) = 10; still 2 short for full 12.
maria: i can push legal for temporary carve to let pilot B run degraded, but ops needs clear mitigation notes for customers.
tariq: what's the incremental cost for air-bridge 2 racks? ballpark?
olivia: carrier quoted $18k/rack expedited. so 2 racks ≈ $36k. finance sign-off required.
jordan: suggested plan: move 6 from staging -> EU, accept partner expedite for 4, pilot B runs at 10/12 with a credit and strict timeline; keep air-bridge as fallback.
maria: agree. i'll draft customer comms + credit note. olivia — update invoice and confirm partner expedite by EOD. tariq — schedule staging move and ETA. jordan — draft customer-facing timeline.
olivia: pinged partner @carrier-contact and CC'd customs-broker. will confirm invoice update.
tariq: staging pickup same-day, transit ~18h to EU consolidation hub, +12h final mile. posting tracking when booked.
jordan: draft line for customers: "Due to an unexpected customs hold, your pilot will initially run at reduced capacity. We will provide a credit for the impacted period. Full capacity expected by <date+5d>."
maria: timeline checklist: 1) partner confirm expedite (olivia) 2) invoice amendment (olivia) 3) staging move scheduled (tariq) 4) customer comms ready (jordan) 5) finance fallback approval (maria). react with :thumbsup: when done.
supply-bot: [alert] hold_status_change order=RC-9812 status=HOLD ts=1768504355
maria: if partner confirms only 4 expedite, we'll go with the plan. if they can't do expedite, authorize air-bridge? i need a go/no-go by 16:00 UTC.
olivia: partner tentatively ok for 4, they want the amended invoice in next 2 hours. i'll upload and confirm.
tariq: staging move booked for 13:00 UTC pickup. expected on-site 08:00 UTC next day.
jordan: customer comms ready for review. pushing to legal for the credit wording.
maria: thanks all. i'll escalate finance for emergency approval if invoice not in by 15:30. closing notes in partner channel once confirmed.
